defs.def: one of the large land masses of the earth such as Europe, Asia or Africa 大陆；陆地；洲

ex.s: Cao ___67___ (walk) through 34 countries in six continents and in 2016, he reached the top of Kilimanjaro, Africa’s ___68___ (high) mountain.
ex.t: 曹___67___ (walk)徒步走过六大洲34个国家，2016年他登上了非洲最高峰乞力马扎罗山___68___ (high)。

ex.s: There are no more continents and no more moons to search for, little left to discover.
ex.t: 我们从每个角度观察了我们的星球，发现了所有最狂野的事物。

ex.s: My family and I have managed to cross the North American continent, from western to eastern Canada, in two weeks!
ex.t: 我和家人已经成功穿越了北美大陆，从加拿大西部到东部，只用了两周时间！

ex.s: As the name suggests, it is located on the west of the continent, and takes up about one-third of the continent’s landmass.
ex.t: 顾名思义，它位于大陆的西部，约占大陆面积的三分之一。

ex.s: Shackleton’s goal was to become the first person to cross the frozen continent of Antarctica.
ex.t: 沙克尔顿的目标是成为第一个穿越南极洲冰冻大陆的人。

ex.s: Antarctica: the Last Continent Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth.
ex.t: 南极洲：最后的大陆南极洲是地球上最冷的地方。

ex.s: Covering about 14 million square kilometres around the South Pole, it is the fifth largest continent in the world.
ex.t: 它覆盖南极点周围约1400万平方公里，是世界第五大洲。

ex.s: When the explorers first set foot upon the continent of North American, the skies and lands were alive with an astonishing variety of wildlife.
ex.t: 当探险者首次踏上北美大陆时，天空和大地充满了惊人多样的野生动物。

defs.def: the main part of the continent of Europe, not including Britain or Ireland 欧洲大陆（不包括英国和爱尔兰）

ex.s: Familiar examples include Earth as the center of the universe and the stability of continents.
ex.t: 熟悉的例子包括地球是宇宙中心以及大陆稳定不变的观点。
